column3: If a person takes and carries away the personal property of another with intent to steal and the property is worth more than 1000 dollars, the person shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for not more than five years.
If a person steals the personal property of another, the person shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for not more than one year.
If a person takes anything of value from another person by force or by intimidation, the person shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than fifteen years.
If a person kills another person with malice aforethought, the person shall be punished by imprisonment for any term of years or for life.
If a person kills another person without malice, the person shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for not more than fifteen years.
If a person wilfully destroys or damages a building or property of another, the person shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for not more than five years.
If a person finds property in a park, the person must turn the property in to the superintendent as soon as practicable.
If a person violates a park regulation, the person shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment for not more than six months.
